authority: Controller 0-C acceptance PENDING; this freezes an implementation interface only

bar_contract.boundaries: UTC-aligned half-open [open,end), close_time_ms=end-1; explicit completed flag mandatory
bar_contract.clock_order: bar_end <= source_event_ms <= received_ms <= available_ms <= durable_ms <= decision_ms <= scheduled_review_ms < expires_ms
bar_contract.duplicates: Exact immutable receipt replay deduplicated before decision; content conflict under same identity hard stop
bar_contract.gaps: Every interval in admitted prefix must exist; no forward-fill. Missing/unsorted input fails closed. 1H absent is optional; supplied malformed 1H blocks confirmation, not a standalone signal.
bar_contract.prefix: As-of both end<=trigger and durable<=decision. Latest mandatory 4H and 1D end=floor(trigger/interval)*interval. No sorting of input to conceal out-of-order; adapters admit ascending per series.
bar_contract.revisions: Append revision with new availability and increasing revision. Multiple visible revisions veto a new candidate and cancel dependent open episode. Future revision cannot mutate earlier decision.
bar_contract.stale: decision-trigger>300000 or missing latest expected close => DATA_UNAVAILABLE; stale display never arms

observation.authority: SYNTHETIC later path classification only; no fills/executions or realized PnL
observation.rule: Only bars opened after decision, received/available by observation as-of; contiguous required horizon, conservative ambiguous entry/exit ordering UNKNOWN. Quote evidence is explicitly simulated; no assumed fill from a touch.
observation.separation: Append observation evidence separately; never rewrite ex-ante decision or infer economic validation

persistence.historical_guards: Unmodified frozen guard references outside import path; sticky 50ms stop, queue128 and per-frame accounting unchanged. No BBO acquisition retained on active path.
persistence.identity: source_id+venue+symbol+interval+open+revision; immutable raw bytes and normalized hash bound by receipt hash
persistence.lifecycle: L23 frozen anchors/CAS revision/time-regression/terminal-immutability invariants adapted without minute bars, notifications, orders or capacity reservations
persistence.replay: Identical normalized as-of receipts/config/clocks => byte-identical canonical decision digest; replay never resets episode status
persistence.reuse: DecisionStore.connect with synchronous FULL; transaction binds source receipts, original LT-A negative/account-veto snapshot, RC decision, prefix/watermark, initial Shadow episode
persistence.snapshot: Adapt existing write_snapshot/save_dashboard using existing ui.page/reporting.document/table and fsync temp+replace+directory fsync; immutable decision file precedes latest pointers. Restart verifies DB and republishes partial latest snapshots.

program_b.compatibility: No changes to original ClosedBar, Opportunity, decide, evaluate or B contract. RC snapshot is explicitly versioned and old snapshots never activate it.
program_b.decision: Implement bounded synthetic adapter/compiler/replay proof under new RC V1; native qualification remains FALSE

strategy.account: Always ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN/ACCOUNT_VETO; no account model, actual holdings, execution or probability inferred
strategy.cost_method: 2*max(entry,all target zones)*(fee+slippage)/10000 + entry*(spread+funding_carry*holding_days)/10000; adverse projection, no favorable credit or executable-R claim
strategy.entry: Worst-entry region from current closed 4H recovery and EMA10: min(EMA10,close)-0.05ATR to max(EMA10,close)+0.05ATR; no current quote claim
strategy.episode_identity: SHA256(product,strategy version,symbol,setup trigger,causal prefix hash); review/restart do not reset setup age
strategy.kernel: Reuse platform.strategies.direction with FeaturePipeline on the strictly available 4H prefix
strategy.planned_R: Disclose gross and conservative modeled after-cost geometry; eligible labels among 2R/3R/4R only when nearest fixed target supports threshold
strategy.regime: Daily and 4H EMA10/EMA30 order with EMA30 slope over 3 bars; same direction mandatory. ADX14 and ATR14 disclosed diagnostics, not fitted probabilities.
strategy.retired: S2/S3 RESEARCH_ONLY. No dynamic registry, legacy aliases/API or historical snapshot activation. Original evaluate remains disabled.
strategy.stop: Most recent lag-confirmed protective pivot plus 0.15ATR and (spread+slippage) price buffer; never move stop to force R
strategy.structure: Reuse confirmed_pivots(left=2,right=2). Long requires last two confirmed lows rising; short requires last two confirmed highs falling. Confirmation ends and availability must precede setup decision.
strategy.targets: Fixed preobservable confirmed pivot zones strictly beyond entry. Nearest overhead/underfoot zone must itself pass after-cost 2R; cannot skip obstruction to force 3R/4R.

versioning: No breaking change to this frozen interface; any new schema requires explicit version and migration tests

workload_predeclaration.benchmark: 30 finite 3-symbol close/decision batches, 9 coincident closes, bounded backfill, SQLite writer contention, crash and restart; report counts and P50/P95/P99/max
workload_predeclaration.clock_measurement: Synthetic close/source-delay clocks plus perf_counter_ns elapsed pipeline+durable storage. Report modeled total and actual processing separately; no native timing qualification.
workload_predeclaration.exclusions: Finite offline storage/processing workload; not sustained native capacity, seven-day source qualification, M1B150/s, economics, OOS or Alpha
workload_predeclaration.fixture: 80 synthetic days generated from 1H bars, 4H/1D aggregated; explicitly constructed trend/pullback end plus flat negative counterpart
workload_predeclaration.normal_arrivals: 3 1H bars/hour + 3 4H bars/4h + 3 1D bars/day; offline replay in batches<=4096
workload_predeclaration.repair_limit: At most TWO narrow implementation/test repair rounds after initial RC baseline; unresolved critical defect => PARTIAL_INTEGRATION
